headline: Ghana National Health Insurance Authority Disburses Two Hundred Ten Million Cedis
summary: The National Health Insurance Authority disbursed over GH¢210 million to credentialed healthcare service providers across Ghana and warned against illegal patient charges.
why: Timely public health funding disbursements ensure operational liquidity for medical service providers and stabilize healthcare delivery sectors in developing economies.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Health insurance fund disbursements provide liquidity to healthcare providers in Ghana.
